title: Pilot GLP-1R in Dedifferentiated Liposarcoma
official: A Pilot Study Evaluating GLP-1R Agonist Semaglutide in Patients With Dedifferentiated Liposarcoma
summary: This study will evaluate the biological effects of the GLP-1 receptor agonist semaglutide in adults with dedifferentiated liposarcoma.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participant must have histologically confirmed dedifferentiated liposarcoma.
* Participants must have measurable dedifferentiated liposarcoma disease, defined as at least one lesion that can be accurately measured in at least one dimension (longest diameter to be recorded for non-nodal lesions and short axis for nodal lesions) as ≥20 mm (≥2 cm) by chest x-ray or as ≥10 mm (≥1 cm) with CT scan, MRI, or calipers by clinical exam. See Section 12 (Measurement of Effect) for the evaluation of measurable disease.
* Participants must have disease consistent with de-differentiated liposarcoma that is safely accessible for core needle biopsies.
* ECOG performance status ≤2 (Karnofsky ≥60%, see Appendix A).
* Participants must have adequate organ and marrow function as defined below:

  * Hemoglobin ≥ 8.0 g/dL
  * absolute neutrophil count ≥1,000/mcL
  * platelets ≥90,000/mcL
  * total bilirubin ≤1.5 × institutional upper limit of normal (ULN)
  * AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤3.0 × institutional ULN (unless liver metastases are present in which case it must be ≤ 5 × ULN)
  * Glomerular filtration rate (GFR) ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m2
* Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected participants on effective non-CYP3A4 interacting (see Section 3.2.3) anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months are eligible for this trial.
* For participants with evidence of chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, the HBV viral load must be undetectable on suppressive therapy, if indicated.
* Participants with a history of hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection must have been treated and cured. For participants with HCV infection who are currently on treatment, they are eligible if they have an undetectable HCV viral load.
* Participants with treated brain metastases are eligible if follow-up brain imaging after central nervous system (CNS)-directed therapy shows no evidence of progression.
* Participants must be disease-free of prior invasive malignancies for \> 3 years with the exception of curatively-treated basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin or carcinoma in situ of the cervix. NOTE: If there is a history of prior malignancy, participants must not be receiving other specific treatment for that cancer.
* Participants should have completed prior treatment for their cancer: chemotherapy or radiotherapy must have been completed for greater than 2 weeks (6 weeks for nitrosoureas or mitomycin C) prior to entering the study.
* Participants should have recovered from adverse events due to prior anti-cancer therapy (i.e., have residual toxicities ≤ Grade 1) with the exception of alopecia or neuropathy.
* Participants with known history or current symptoms of cardiac disease, or history of treatment with cardiotoxic agents, should have a clinical risk assessment of cardiac function using the New York Heart Association Functional Classification. To be eligible for this trial, participants should be class 2B or better.
* Participants must be willing to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study including undergoing treatment and scheduled visits and examinations including follow-up.
* Ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document.
* Participants must have a body mass index (BMI) ≥ 25.
* Participants must be able to self-inject semaglutide or be able to make arrangements to have it injected.
* Participants can have localized or metastatic disease.
* Any line of therapy, including no prior systemic therapy, is allowed.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior exposure to any GLP1R agonist drug.
* Participants with rapidly progressing, symptomatic disease and/or bulky disease who, in the opinion of the investigator, would not reasonably be able to tolerate a period of 4 months without therapy. If there is a question regarding the appropriateness of enrollment, the PI should be consulted.
* Participants with uncontrolled intercurrent illness, including but not limited to active serious infection, cardiac disease, or conditions that in the opinion of the investigator would compromise participant safety or study participation.
* Participants with any diagnosis of diabetes (type 1 or type 2).
* Participants who are currently receiving any standard or investigational agents for their cancer.
* Participants with psychiatric illness and /or social situations that would limit compliance with study requirements.
* Pregnant women are excluded from this study because semaglutide is an agent with the potential for teratogenic or abortifacient effects. Because there is an unknown but potential risk for adverse events in nursing infants secondary to treatment of the mother with semaglutide, breastfeeding should be discontinued if the mother is treated with semaglutide. These potential risks may also apply to other agents used in this study.
* History of allergic reactions attributed to compounds of similar chemical or biologic composition to semaglutide.
* Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or MEN2.
* History of acute or chronic symptomatic pancreatitis.
* Concomitant treatment with insulin or insulin secretagogues (e.g., sulfonylureas or meglitinides).
* Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) \<30 mL/min/1.73 m2 or end-stage renal disease.
* Current symptomatic cholelithiasis or cholecystitis, or a history of recurrent gallbladder disease not definitively treated (e.g., no prior cholecystectomy). Asymptomatic cholelithiasis not requiring intervention is allowed.
* Participants with a history of having received prior pharmacological or surgical weight-loss interventions.
